verification.scenario: Admin creates catalog and staff; client orders; employee completes; SQLite survives restart
verification.scope: Full service/handover journey; payment pending, in-app mock notifications

items.name: a01-admin-login
items.title: 01 · Administrator sign-in
items.description: The administrator enters through a separate staff portal. The client-facing 3D world is not used as the administration dashboard.

items.name: a02-employee-created
items.title: 02 · Create an employee account
items.description: The administrator creates an operator account with the employee role. Server-side permissions limit the employee to operational actions.

items.name: a03-service-prices-duration
items.title: 03 · Publish prices and estimated times
items.description: A new ceramic-protection service is configured for four vehicle categories: Carro $44 / 27 min, Pickup $52 / 35 min, Truck $62 / 45 min, SUV $48 / 30 min. These are demonstration prices.

items.name: a04-published-offer
items.title: 04 · Publish a seasonal offer
items.description: The administrator publishes Cuidado de temporada. The same content is shown to the customer later in this sequence.

items.name: c01-customer-registration
items.title: 05 · Customer registration
items.description: A new customer registers from Mi cuenta in the spatial web app. Only synthetic test data is used in this walkthrough.

items.name: c02-customer-account
items.title: 06 · Private customer account
items.description: Registration establishes a private customer account. Customer access is separate from employee and administrator permissions.

items.name: c03-service-selected
items.title: 07 · Choose a service for the vehicle
items.description: The customer selects the newly published ceramic-protection service for Carro. Its $44 base price comes from the administrator configuration.

items.name: c04-vehicle-details
items.title: 08 · Review vehicle details
items.description: The customer reviews the vehicle information before requesting a quotation. The walkthrough follows one demonstration order through the remaining stages.

items.name: c05-quote-review
items.title: 09 · Review the quotation
items.description: The customer reviews the selected service, estimated time and itemized quotation before confirming. The demonstration total is $49.06, including $5.06 tax.

items.name: c06-order-confirmed
items.title: 10 · Confirm the order
items.description: The order is confirmed, but physical arrival and payment remain pending. Browsing the virtual site does not automatically check in a vehicle or charge the customer.

items.name: e01-arrival-confirmed
items.title: 11 · Employee confirms arrival
items.description: An authenticated employee confirms the physical arrival. The order enters the operational queue and becomes visible in the customer waiting view.

items.name: c07-waiting-status
items.title: 12 · Customer follows the queue
items.description: The customer consults the lounge terminal to see queue position and pending tasks for the same order. The state comes from the backend.

items.name: e02-service-active
items.title: 13 · Employee assigns service
items.description: The employee assigns attention and sees ceramic protection in progress. Operations use a conventional staff dashboard connected to the customer experience.

items.name: c08-track-vehicle
items.title: 14 · Customer tracks the assigned bay
items.description: Ver mi auto navigates to the assigned bay. The spatial view displays the service state and elapsed time reported by the operation.

items.name: e03-ready-for-handover
items.title: 15 · Service ready for handover
items.description: The employee simulates service completion and reviews the order before confirming handover. Completion is an explicit operational action.

items.name: c09-private-completion-notice
items.title: 16 · Customer receives completion notice
items.description: The customer receives a private in-app completion notification for the same order. This is a mock notification adapter; external email, SMS and messaging are not connected.

items.name: c10-order-history
items.title: 17 · Sign in again and recover the order
items.description: After handover, the customer signs out and signs in again. The private account restores the completed order from SQLite. Payment remains pending; this walkthrough does not simulate a successful payment.

items.name: c11-offer-visible-to-customer
items.title: 18 · Customer sees the published offer
items.description: The lounge displays the seasonal offer created by the administrator at the start of the walkthrough, demonstrating shared configured content.

items.name: a05-orders-dashboard
items.title: 19 · Administrator reviews the order
items.description: The administrator reviews the order list after the service and handover flow. This closes the demonstration across customer, employee and administrator roles.
